sections.Profile:
The "Elite Guard" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1968, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Ed Krynski, with artwork by Art Stenholm. This machine is an "add-a-ball" version of Gottlieb's "Palace Guard," specifically produced for export to Italy.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1968
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: People, Single Player, Wedgehead, Original Theme
